capabilities: adopt a pixel-art bird that hops around your apps and pages
collect falling feathers to unlock 30+ bird species
dress the bird in hats from a dozen options
create sticky notes that persist across refreshes
pet the bird and toggle its visibility from its menu
extras: The README is mostly written for the standalone browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, userscript, website embed); the Obsidian plugin is one of several distribution targets, so parts of the adoption guide and permission FAQ don't apply to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian offers no lighthearted companion or ambient decoration while working in the vault.
summary: Desktop pet that adds a pixel-art bird hopping over your vault, with collectible species, hats, and sticky notes.
